$comment: Input of scripts/gen-hsm-svd.js, which writes bin/svd/HSM_TC3xx.svd.
Addresses are HSM addresses; the bridge registers have the same address on the host.
Register: n name, o offset, r reset (omitted: undefined), a access ro|rw|wo (default rw), d description,
dim/inc/idx expand '%s' in n and d (idx default 0..dim-1), readAction, mwv modifiedWriteValues, f fields.
Field: n name, b 'msb:lsb' or 'bit', a access, d description, e [[value, name, description], ...].
Never mark a field of a readable register write-only: the peripheral viewer then skips the whole register.
Peripheral merge=false: kept out of the XPeripherals view of TriCore sessions (see README).

device.name: HSM_TC3xx
device.description: Hardware Security Module (HSM) of the AURIX TC3xx family (Cortex-M3 r2p0). HSM-internal peripherals (0xE0000000-0xEFFFFFFF) are reached by the host through the HSM debug window and only while DBGCTRL.HSM is set by the HSM firmware.

peripherals.name: HSM_BRIDGE
peripherals.description: HSM bridge, host side (HSM TS 9.3.1, 9.4). Only 32-bit aligned accesses. DBGBASE and HSMOTGB are only accessible while HSM debugging is enabled (DBGCTRL.HSM).

registers.d: Module Identifier Register (for the whole HSM)
Host to HSM Flag Register. The host sets flags (write 1) to request an HSM interrupt; the HSM resets them.
HSM to Host Flag Register. The HSM sets flags to request a host interrupt; the host resets them (write 1).

f.d: Set: flag mapped to host interrupt 1, otherwise host interrupt 0

registers.d: HSM to Host Status (written by the HSM; BOS status, HSM TS 11.3)

f.d: HSM internal status for the host
Host software status for the HSM

registers.d: HSM Control Register (HSM reset / end of memory BIST). Bits can only be set.

f.d: End of Memory BIST test (redundant encoding)
e: MBIST mode deactivated, start of HSM subsystem

registers.d: Debug Base Address Register: upper 16 bits of the HSM address shown in the debug window. Written by the debug server before every window access (read-only here).

f.d: Base address of the debug memory window

registers.d: OCDS Suspend and Trigger Bus Control (cleared by application reset)

f.d: TGS, TGB write protection: TGS and TGB are only written if TG_P is set in the same access. Reads as 0.

peripherals.name: HSM_BRIDGE_HSMSIDE
peripherals.description: HSM bridge, registers accessible by the HSM only (HSM TS 9.3.1-9.3.7). A host access gives a bus error; a debugger access through the HSM debug window reaches a host address through the HSM (possible SPB bus conflict, HSM TS 12.3.6).

f.d: Clock divider of the HSM subsystem
e: Half of the maximum clock frequency
Quarter of the maximum clock frequency

registers.d: Debug Control Register (debug and trace access of host and HSM, redundant encoding)

f.d: Host side tracing of HSM accesses on SPB
Debug control for the host system
Debug control for the HSM subsystem and debug memory window

registers.d: Pin Control Register (writable until LOCK is set, then read-only until reset)
Error Control Register (error flags, cleared by writing 1)

f.d: ECC errors of PKC ROM (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
ECC errors of PKC SCM (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
ECC errors of PKC TCM (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
Address error of cache tag field
ECC errors of cache tag field (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
ECC errors of cache data (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
ECC errors of local RAM (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
ECC errors of HSM boot ROM (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
Host system bus error due to an HSM access
PKC ROM ECC error interrupt enable (1: correctable, 2: uncorrectable, 3: both)
PKC SCM address error interrupt enable
PKC SCM ECC error interrupt enable
PKC TCM address error interrupt enable
PKC TCM ECC error interrupt enable
Cache tag address error interrupt enable
Cache tag ECC error interrupt enable
Cache data address error interrupt enable
Cache data ECC error interrupt enable
Local RAM address error interrupt enable
Local RAM ECC error interrupt enable
Boot ROM ECC error interrupt enable

registers.d: Error Address Register (address of the last bus error)
Single Access to Host Base Address Register

f.d: Base address of the single access to host window (Fxxx: window off)

registers.d: Reset Control Register (writable only while RSTPWD holds 55AA00FFH)

f.d: Application reset enable per sensor flag
System reset enable per sensor flag

peripherals.name: HSM_AES
peripherals.description: AES-128 module (HSM TS 4.4). Only 32-bit accesses; unused addresses give a bus error. Not suspended in HALT mode.

registers.d: AES input register %s (key, IV, plain or cipher text)
AES Control Register (writing triggers the operation)

e: Write input to key register KEYNR
Lock key register K0 or K1
Write input to chaining variable CVNR
Copy chaining variable CVNR to output

f.d: Key number (0-7; 1FH = OLDKEY, key of the last operation)

registers.d: AES output save register %s (output of the previous operation)

peripherals.name: HSM_HASH
peripherals.description: Hash module MD5/SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256 (HSM TS 5.3). Only 32-bit accesses; reading a write-only register gives a bus error.

f.d: Result counter: 32-bit words left in HASH_VAL

registers.d: Hash Initialization Value Register (consecutive writes; a read gives a bus error)
Hash Output Value Register. Each read returns the next result word and decrements HASH_STAT.CNT, so it is not read automatically.
Hash Data Input Register (fills the FIFO; a read gives a bus error)

peripherals.name: HSM_PKC
peripherals.description: Public Key Cryptography module, control and status (HSM TS 6.4.1). Only 32-bit accesses.

registers.d: PKC Configuration Register (operand pointers into the SCM)

f.d: Calculate R^2 mod N before the next operation (cleared by hardware)
Sign of parameter b in Y^2 = X^3 +- aX +- b (1: negative)
Sign of parameter a in Y^2 = X^3 +- aX +- b (1: negative)
Operand size in multiples of 64 bits (1-4)
Start the command in PKC_CMD (cleared when finished)
PKC busy: no SCM access allowed
Fail address of the last invalid point

peripherals.name: HSM_PKC_SCM
peripherals.description: PKC Shared Crypto Memory: 32 long integer registers of 256 bits (HSM TS 6.4.2). Only expand while PKC_STATUS.BUSY = 0: the SCM must not be accessed while the PKC is working.

clusters.d: Shared crypto memory register %s (W0 = bits 31:0 ... W7 = bits 255:224)

peripherals.name: HSM_TIM
peripherals.description: Timer module, timer 0 and timer 1 (HSM TS 7.4). 16-bit registers, addressed wordwise. Suspended in HALT mode.

f.d: Write enable for TF1 in the same access. Reads as 0.
Write enable for TF0 in the same access. Reads as 0.

registers.d: Timer Configuration Register (prescalers; change only while the timer is stopped)

peripherals.name: HSM_WDT
peripherals.description: HSM watchdog timer (HSM TS 8.4). 16-bit registers, addressed wordwise. Suspended in HALT mode; its interrupt is the NMI.

e: Service value incremented with each access

f.d: Clock select (stop the watchdog before changing)

registers.d: Watchdog Service Register. A wrong value triggers a checkpoint mismatch; do not update by read-increment-write.

peripherals.name: HSM_TRNG
peripherals.description: True random number generator (HSM TS 3.4). Suspended in HALT mode.

registers.d: True RNG Data Register. A read consumes the random word (clears DTA_RDY), so it is not read automatically.

f.d: Write enable for WARN in the same access. Reads as 0.
Write enable for FIPS_ERR in the same access. Reads as 0.

e: Data identical to the previous word

peripherals.name: HSM_CACHE
peripherals.description: HSM unified cache (HSM TS 2.5.3). Privileged access only. The command registers are write-only and trigger cache operations.

registers.d: Cache All Clean Register (write: clean and invalidate all blocks)
Cache Set Clean Register (write: clean the set of ADDR[9:4])

peripherals.name: HSM_SCNSCB
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 system control, not in the SCB (ARMv7-M).

f.d: Disable write buffer for default memory map

peripherals.name: HSM_SYSTICK
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 SysTick timer. Reference clock: SPB clock / 16. Suspended in HALT mode (HSM TS 2.2.2).

f.d: Counted to 0 since last read (cleared on read)

registers.d: SysTick Current Value Register (any write clears it)
SysTick Calibration Value Register (62500 = 10 ms at 100 MHz SPB)

peripherals.name: HSM_NVIC
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 NVIC: 10 interrupts, 8 priority levels (3 bits, 7:5 of each priority byte). HSM TS 2.3.

registers.d: Interrupt Clear-Enable Register (reads the enable state)
Interrupt Clear-Pending Register (reads the pending state)

peripherals.name: HSM_SCB
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 System Control Block (ARMv7-M, HSM TS 2.2).

f.d: Pending exception serviced on exit from debug halt

registers.d: Vector Table Offset Register (bits 31:30 added for vector tables in flash, HSM TS 2.3.2)
Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register. Do not set SYSRESETREQ or VECTRESET on the HSM (undefined behaviour, HSM TS 2.2.5).

f.d: Deep sleep (no effect on the HSM except SysTick stop)
Ignore precise bus faults in HardFault/NMI
Enter thread mode with active exceptions

registers.d: System Handler Control and State Register
Configurable Fault Status Register (MMFSR, BFSR, UFSR; write 1 to clear)
Debug Fault Status Register (cleared by the debug server; read-only here)

peripherals.name: HSM_MPU
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 memory protection unit, 8 regions (PMSAv7; C, S and TEX are ignored on the HSM, HSM TS 2.4).

f.d: Default memory map for privileged accesses
Write: use REGION instead of RNR. Reads as 0.

registers.d: MPU Region Attribute and Size Register

peripherals.name: HSM_COREDEBUG
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 core debug registers. Used by the debug server for run control; read-only here.

registers.d: Debug Halting Control and Status Register (reading clears S_RESET_ST and S_RETIRE_ST)

f.d: Halting debug enabled (HSM SW may only set it when HSM debugging is enabled)

registers.d: Debug Exception and Monitor Control Register

peripherals.name: HSM_DWT
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 data watchpoint and trace unit, 4 comparators. The comparators are used by the debug server for watchpoints; read-only here.

f.d: Function (4: PC, 5: read, 6: write, 7: access watchpoint)

peripherals.name: HSM_FPB
peripherals.description: Cortex-M3 flash patch and breakpoint unit, 6 usable code comparators with the HSM's FP_COMPHx extension for 32-bit addresses (HSM TS 12.4.1). Used by the debug server for breakpoints; read-only here.

f.d: Write key (must be 1 on writes). Reads as 0.

registers.d: Flash Patch Comparator Register %s (6 and 7 are literal comparators, unused on the HSM)

f.d: Breakpoint on lower/upper halfword or both

registers.d: Flash Patch Comparator High Register %s (HSM extension)
